recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless the work group wants a new compatibility-impacting decision to rename the style-guide-compliant composite parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-40056 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It asked to address independent Encounter location and location-period searches by creating a composite search element that combines the location reference and location period.
initial_application: Commit d2da51566687fc8a513617b464e65befc990b6dd initially applied the request by changing Encounter-location-period into a composite over Encounter.location with location and period components.
additional_context: FHIR-41251 later corrected the implementation because the composite referenced a missing period sub-search parameter and did not match the search-parameter style guide. Commits 0e4b7b6df6bb707c81ebdde7d5b78336578c392d and f5dc96c451f0ff09011758d5cbed0d0627c6006e restored Encounter.location.period as a date parameter and renamed the composite to location-value-period.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The active Encounter search parameter source defines location-period as a date search parameter and location-value-period as a composite over Encounter.location with components location and location-period.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied correction split the original composite into a date sub-parameter and a style-guide-compliant composite.
